face_visibility: literal source-over in frozen manifest order
scar_visibility: non-helmet scars have a baked inverse union hair/ears mask; helmet damage is baked to the common helmet alpha
rear_neck_mask: species neck polygons and beard/chin occlusion as recorded in registration recipe
build_mask: species colour/silhouette masks as recorded in registration recipe; source pixels unchanged
option_geometry_contract: Original source dimensions, IDs and draw order unchanged; positive destination scale and selected earlier-slot alpha or measured source-space polygon masks only.
